topic: Day 9 — carousel — A bigger life without presence is just a longer list of absences

slides.text: A packed calendar with an absent mind is still empty.
Presence is what makes a moment count, not the moment.
Otherwise you're just collecting absences, not memories.

caption:
Chasing more experiences while mentally somewhere else just produces a longer list of things you weren't really there for. Presence is what makes a moment count.

Follow for one of these a day.
